title: Isolation of exosomal RNA from serum or plasma using the Norgen BioTek Plasma/Serum circulating and exosomal RNA purification mini kit
protocol: Set incubator to 60°C.
Warm PS Solution A, PS Solution B, and PS Solution C for 20 minutes.
Add 50 mL of 96-100% ethanol to Wash Solution.
Note the addition of ethanol on the bottle.
Add 10 µL 2-Mercaptoethanol per 1 mL PS Solution B.
Transfer 500 µL biofluid into a microfuge tube.
Add 100 µL PS Solution A to the biofluid.
Add 900 µL PS Solution B containing 2-Mercaptoethanol to the mixture.
Vortex for 15 seconds.
Incubate for 10 min at 60°C.
Add 1.5 mL 100% Ethanol to the mixture.
Vortex for 15 seconds.
Centrifuge for 30 seconds at 100 x g at room temperature.
Discard supernatant carefully, avoiding disruption of pellet.
To the pellet add 750 µL PS Solution C.
Vortex for 15 seconds.
Incubate for 10 min at 60°C.
Add 750 µL 100% Ethanol to the mixture.
Vortex for 15 seconds.
Assemble a mini filter Spin Column with a collection tube.
Transfer 650 µL of the mixture to the Filter Column.
Centrifuge for 1 min at 16,000 x g at room temperature.
Discard flow-through from the column.
Repeat steps 17-19 until all of the mixture has been added to the Filter Column.
Add 400 µL Wash Solution to the column.
Centrifuge for 1 min at 16,000 x g at room temperature.
Discard flow-through from the column.
Repeat steps 21-23 two more times for a total of 3 washes.
Open the cap of the column and centrifuge for 3 minutes at 16,000 x g at room temperature to dry the column.
Discard collection tube.
Transfer the spin column to a fresh 1.7 mL elution tube.
Apply 30 µL water to the column.
Centrifuge for 2 mins at 300 x g at room temperature to load the solution onto the column.
Centrifuge for 3 min at 16,000 x g at room temperature to elute the RNA.
